name: Taproot
summary: Taproot (BIP-340/341/342) introduced Schnorr signatures, Taproot (merkleized alternative script trees), and Tapscript. Makes multi-sig and complex scripts indistinguishable from single-sig on-chain, improving privacy and efficiency. Activated via Speedy Trial.
summaryZh: 主根升级（BIP-340/341/342）引入了 Schnorr 签名、Taproot（默克尔化替代脚本树）和 Tapscript。使多重签名和复杂脚本在链上与单签名无法区分，提升了隐私性和效率。通过 Speedy Trial 激活。
